nui 1
const Unit: number = 26
const Delta: number = 36
const Ticks: number[] = [1,2]
for Tick in @Ticks carry Values: number[] = [26, 62] carry Total: number = 36 {
const Mapped: number[] = for Item in @Values { if (@Tick > 0) { @Item + @Tick } else { 1 / 0 } }
const Before: number = @Values[0]
point Incoming = coordinate(x: @Before, y: @Total)
next Values = @Mapped
next Total = @Total + @Values[1]
}
const Final0: number = @Values[0]
const Final1: number = @Values[1]
const Final2: number = @Total
